3812.title: Plugin overlay hook does not update native browser visibility
3812.rootCauseOneLine: The registry hook is a no-op, so plugin overlays never increment the host counter that gates native browser visibility.
3812.proposedFix: Design a host-backed experimental SDK overlay lifecycle and wire the plugin registry hook to it, with cleanup and native desktop coverage.
3812.caveats: Hook-level reproduction only; native occlusion and screenshots unverified. No automatic fix because a public SDK/interface decision exceeds simple-fix scope.
